designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1982 when the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service acquired part of the San Bernardino Ranch to protect its springs and endangered native fishes.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
